messages:
sophie lim: Quick heads-up 10 — Solaris Health signed a short ISV trial to list Redwood on their Marketplace-managed stack. This is an Azure Marketplace pilot + dedicated capacity trial for 3 months.

sophie lim: They'll be testing our Dedicated runtime behind their private VNet and want an official Marketplace listing if pilot metrics look good.

omar gomez: Great! SE will own the perf matrix. I'll run a baseline on 2x A10G nodes and document throughput/latency SLOs.

omar gomez: Also adding a note: Solaris asked for a sample deployment manifest and minimal firewall rules.

ivy (sales): Awesome win. Deal team updated the CRM and marked as "pilot - marketplace". Estimated MRR if converted: $18k/mo.

hannah (prod-marketing): Can we capture a logo lock and permission for a short quote post-pilot? I'll prepare a marketplace listing draft + one-pager.

maria (legal): Confirmed standard MSFT Marketplace contract flow. I uploaded the marketplace addendum and the reseller terms to the drive: https://redwood.internal/solarismkt/docs

kai (security): Security review queued. Need their SOC2 report and IP allowlist for the VNet peers. Solaris please upload to the shared folder before kickoff.

sophie lim: @kai noted. Solaris contact is amanda@solarismeds.com (cc'd on the purchase order). Kickoff scheduled Monday 9am PT. Invite sent.

omar gomez: Quick config snippet I'll include in the kickoff doc:

```yaml
redwood:
  deployment: dedicated
  nodes: 2
  gpu: a10g
  kv_cache: enabled
  quant_profile: default-safe
```

ivy (sales): Can we include a marketplace SKU id in the deal folder so finance can model ARR?

maria (legal): I'll add the SKU mapping once the listing draft is ready.

hannah (prod-marketing): I'll own the marketplace draft + small hero one-pager. If pilot converts, we'll do a joint case study and a short webinar.

deploy-bot: [integration] 1891235600 12 12 8kickoff-invite.ics posted

omar gomez: Action items: 1) Baseline perf doc (omar) 2) Marketplace draft & one-pager (hannah) 3) Legal marketplace addendum (maria) 4) Security checklist & SOC2 (kai) 5) CRM & SKU mapping (ivy).

sophie lim: Thanks team 10. Big step for Marketplace GTM. Please tag me on blockers and drop notes in the marketplace folder. :tada:
